## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new 60-second default leaves the README still promising a 30-second timeout, so the user-facing docs need updating before users depend on the wrong value. The code change itself is correct, and `test_defaults` asserts the new default.

## Changes
The pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README's stated 30-second default — `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` makes `README.md:3` false: running without `--timeout` now waits 60 seconds, but the README still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users and operators who rely on the README will expect a 30-second default and misjudge how long requests can hang. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
